correctness.rationale: The actual finite deleted-product square model uses 15 unordered vertex-pair 0-cells, 60 edge/vertex 1-cells and 45 disjoint-edge square 2-cells with checked orientation and B1B2=0. Independently computed exact Smith normal form for M=B2^T: 35 unit factors then 2; free rank9 and Z/2 in H2. The natural ten motion cochains plus fourteen vertex coboundaries have 24 primitive unit invariant factors and rank24, so form the full integer 1-cocycle lattice. The 45x75 matrix of coboundaries together with the 15 naturally disjoint non-tree square cup classes has all 45 Smith factors 1: integral, not merely rational, cup surjectivity. Independently verified specified cochain identity M(x-2q)=2tau and nonmembership of tau in im M by rank_mod2([M|tau])=36 versus rank_mod2(M)=35; tau nonzero of exact order2. Higher cells absent.
